About Builds Your Mind

About Builds Your Mind

Hands-on STEM programmes, workshops and educational kits for schools and colleges — by Harmono Pvt. Ltd.

Our Story

Who We Are

Builds Your Mind is the education brand of Harmono Pvt. Ltd., focused on practical STEM learning for schools, colleges and learners of all ages.

All products are designed, manufactured and quality-tested by our parent company Harmono Pvt. Ltd., ensuring consistent quality, scalability and innovation in every educational kit we produce.

We believe that education should not come at the cost of our environment. That's why every product we create is designed with sustainability in mind, using recyclable materials and eco-friendly packaging.

Our Mission

Make practical STEM learning ordinary

Every session should leave students with something they built, tested and can explain — not just something they watched.

Our Vision

Institutions that can run it themselves

A classroom where science and technology are learned by doing, and where every institution can run hands-on sessions with its own teachers.

How We Work
  • Programmes are planned around the class groups an institution gives us.
  • Sessions run at the institution, with its teachers involved.
  • Case studies and photographs are published only with written permission.
  • Kits are designed, manufactured and quality-tested by Harmono Pvt. Ltd.
How We Teach

Our Approach: Learning by Building

We believe students understand an idea best when they build it. Our workshops and kits are built around doing — assembling a circuit, testing a robot, fixing what did not work, and explaining why.

That is why our sessions are practical rather than theoretical, and why they are designed to be run with your own class groups.
